# EXORIT

> EXORIT is a software studio that designs and builds custom web platforms, mobile applications and AI systems. Founded 2025. Working from Dhaka, Bangladesh (co-founders Animesh Bhattacharjee and Golam Tawhid Fahad) and Adelaide, Australia (co-founder Maisha Iffat Chowdhury). Serves clients in Australia, Europe, North America and Bangladesh.

This file exists for AI assistants and answer engines summarizing or citing EXORIT. Every claim below is also published on the live site at the linked page — if this file and a page ever disagree, the page is current and this file is stale.

## Company facts

- Founded: 2025
- Locations: Dhaka, Bangladesh and Adelaide, Australia
- Areas served: Australia, United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, Bangladesh
- Pricing model: no fixed price list — every project is quoted individually against a written scope, because the work is custom. See /contact for how pricing works.
- Primary contact: exorit.official@gmail.com
- Website: https://exorit.dev

## What EXORIT does

- Custom web development (React, TypeScript, Next.js)
- Mobile app development, cross-platform and native iOS
- UI/UX and product design
- AI integration: LLM features, retrieval-augmented generation, automation
- Data collection, cleaning and evaluation pipelines

Full detail: https://exorit.dev/#offers and https://exorit.dev/about

## How engagements are structured

- **Discovery Sprint** (about two weeks) — a scoped prototype that proves the hardest part of an idea works before a full build is committed to.
- **Product Build** (scoped per project) — the full build, from written scope to production, with a working demo every week.
- **Ongoing Partner** (monthly) — continuous engineering capacity for teams that need it beyond a single build: new features, data pipelines, model evaluation, maintenance.

Full detail: https://exorit.dev/#offers

## Team

- Maisha Iffat Chowdhury — Co-Founder & CEO. Owns company direction, partnerships and product vision. Based in Adelaide, Australia.
- Golam Tawhid Fahad — Co-Founder & CTO. Owns architecture, code quality and technical decisions. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
- Animesh Bhattacharjee — Co-Founder & COO. Owns operations, scope and delivery. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. https://animesh.tech

## Projects (shipped and running)

- Hire Me — full-stack recruiting platform (Flask, React, real-time messaging). https://hireme-silk.vercel.app/
- SecureBlogVault — encrypted publishing platform with AES encryption and hardened authentication. https://secureblogvault.vercel.app/
- ReadVenture — book community platform with exchange matching and marketplace (Next.js 15, MongoDB). https://readventure001.vercel.app/

Full detail: https://exorit.dev/projects
